layout_and_grids.dashboard_mode: Mode B: High Density Bento Grid with asymmetric hero quick-create + live project cards
layout_and_grids.project_card_aspect: 3:2 preview frame showing real SVG/canvas snapshot thumbnail + dynamic element count badge + MCP token quick status
layout_and_grids.canvas_workspace: Full-bleed dual-layer interface: top header bar (fixed z-30 with breadcrumbs, live sync status, agent inspector toggle, export suite) + live @excalidraw canvas + floating MCP HUD drawer + bottom left element timeline

key_components_structure.description: Minimalist high-trust developer login with Google OAuth integration, live features preview carousel, and local bypass for instant sandboxed demo testing.
Master canvas hub with search, tag filters, 'Create New Canvas' dialog with templates (System Architecture, Sequence Flow, Database Schema, Cloud Mesh), rename/delete modals, and batch export.
Hardened embedded Excalidraw editor wrapped with real-time WebSocket subscriber, synchronizing AI MCP actions (create elements, move, colorize, connect arrows) with persistent DB updates.

Slide-over or expandable command center for connecting Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or custom MCP clients. Displays project-specific token, claude_desktop_config.json snippet, live stream logs of incoming MCP tool calls, and test ping tool.
High fidelity export actions: PNG with transparent/solid background, SVG vector download, direct .excalidraw file export, and instant 'Open in excalidraw.com' integration.

image_urls.description: Workspace with whiteboard diagrams and software system blueprint
Digital sketching stylus on tablet with code on desktop monitor

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. JavaScript React only: Use .js and .jsx extension conventions.
2. Strict data-testid: Every button, input, tab, card, and modal MUST contain semantic kebab-case data-testid tags.
3. Real WebSocket & Persistence: Embed @excalidraw/excalidraw cleanly with resilient WebSocket sync and fallback REST polling for diagram persistence.
4. MCP Setup Experience: Provide 1-click copy for Claude Desktop config, Cursor config, Windsurf, and direct MCP curl instructions.

5. Live Agent Inspector: Include an interactive 'Simulate AI Agent Draw' trigger directly in the UI so users can watch their diagrams draw autonomously in real-time even without external Claude connected.
6. No transparent menus: All dropdowns, popovers, and sticky headers must have solid or heavy backdrop blur backgrounds.
7. Responsive & Ergonomic: Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+S for save, Esc for panel close, Ctrl+E for export menu).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not generate generic gray boxes or centered landing text. Use high contrast, crisp monospaced telemetry tags, live socket pulses, and rich architectural diagram templates.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for all user notifications (token copied, canvas saved, agent connected).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure all text satisfies APCA / WCAG AA contrast standards, focus rings are prominent and styled with indigo highlight.
